preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 3 and 200,000.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U[i] <= N and 1 <= V[i] <= N for i in range(N-1))
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect vertices within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P[i] <= N and 1 <= Q[i] <= N and P[i] != Q[i] for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each query must specify valid vertices P and Q within the range of 1 to N, and P must not be a leaf.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max_length) for max_length in results
postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum length of the cool sequence for each query.
